categoryName: Nutraceuticals — protein, multivitamin, calcium, iron, omega, immunity, ayurveda (chyawanprash, giloy), electrolytes

skuLines.line: Whey protein concentrate, mainstream 1 kg tub
skuLines.examples: MuscleBlaze Beginner's Whey 1 kg; Nakpro Impact Whey 1 kg; Bigmuscles Essential Whey 1 kg; Optimum Nutrition Performance Whey 1 kg
skuLines.priceBand: ₹900-2,000 for Indian brands; ₹3,700-4,000 for imported ON/MuscleBlaze Biozyme
skuLines.seasonality: Spikes at session start (Jul-Aug, Jan) and before sports meets; dips during exams and vacations
skuLines.marginBand: 20-35% on Indian brands; 10-18% on imported ON-type
skuLines.notes: 18-month shelf life but cakes badly in Baru Sahib monsoon humidity — buy 1 kg not 2 kg, keep tubs sealed off the floor. Dairy-derived so acceptable to a vegetarian institution; state that on the shelf tag.

skuLines.line: Whey protein starter pack / single-serve sachet
skuLines.examples: AS-IT-IS ATOM Beginners Whey 1 kg; MuscleBlaze 500 g; single-serve 30-35 g sachets
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; sachets peak with new-batch students trying protein for the first time
skuLines.marginBand: 25-40% (sachets carry the best margin per gram)
skuLines.notes: The sachet is the trial SKU for a closed campus — a student will not commit ₹1,800 to a flavour they have never tasted. Also the only whey format that does not go stale on a slow-moving shelf.

skuLines.examples: Bigmuscles Nitra Isolate 1 kg; Nakpro Impact Isolate; avvatar Alpha Whey; MuscleBlaze Biozyme Performance
skuLines.notes: Carry 2-3 SKUs only. High ticket, slow turns, and a ₹4,000 tub that expires is the single most expensive dead stock in this category. Better handled as an indent-on-order line than shelf stock.

skuLines.examples: Nakpro Plant Protein; Oziva Plant Protein; Patanjali Nutrela Soya Protein; MyProtein Vegan Blend
skuLines.notes: Matters more here than in a city store: a Sikh institution with heavy vegetarianism and lactose-intolerant residents needs a non-dairy, gelatin-free protein option. Pea/soy/rice blends; check for gelatin in the flavour system, not just the protein source.

skuLines.examples: MuscleBlaze Mass Gainer XXL 1 kg; Bigmuscles Real Mass; Endura Mass 500 g; Patanjali Nutrela Weight Gain
skuLines.seasonality: Peaks Jul-Sep with new hostel intake; underweight teenage boys are a steady base here
skuLines.notes: Endura Mass 500 g at the ₹350 end is the mass-market entry and moves far better than a ₹2,500 XXL tub on a campus. Same monsoon caking risk as whey.

skuLines.examples: MuscleBlaze Protein Bar 10 g/20 g; Yoga Bar 20 g Protein Bar; RiteBite Max Protein; The Whole Truth protein bar
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes during exam weeks and sports events
skuLines.notes: Impulse SKU — must sit at the POS counter, not on the supplement shelf. Verify gelatin-free (many bars use bovine gelatin in the coating) before listing in this institution. 9-12 month shelf life, chocolate coating blooms if the store gets warm.

skuLines.line: High-protein nutrition powder for adults (Protinex type)
skuLines.examples: Protinex Rich Chocolate 400 g; Protinex Original; Apollo Pharmacy Daily Protein 200 g; Prohance
skuLines.packSizes: 200 g, 250 g, 400 g jar, 750 g refill
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; recovery-driven, so spikes after illness and in the post-monsoon fever season
skuLines.notes: This, not whey, is what a 45-year-old teacher and a recovering patient actually buy. Verified Apollo price ₹506 for the 400 g jar (Aug 2026). Thin margin but very high frequency — treat as a footfall driver.

skuLines.line: Complete adult nutrition powder, standard and diabetic
skuLines.examples: Ensure Balanced Nutrition 400 g/950 g; Ensure Diabetes Care 400 g/950 g; Prohance-D; Nestle Resource Diabetic
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; a chronic-use line, not seasonal
skuLines.notes: Live Apollo prices Aug 2026: Ensure Diabetes Care 950 g ₹1,810; Ensure Balanced 950 g ₹1,453. Diabetic variants are the fastest-moving half in a staff population of this age profile. Perfect standing-order candidate — the same 8 households buy it every month.

skuLines.examples: PediaSure Vanilla/Chocolate 400 g & 950 g; Complan Royale 500 g/1 kg refill; Horlicks Growth+; Nutrigro by Complan
skuLines.packSizes: 200 g, 400 g jar, 500 g refill, 950 g-1 kg refill
skuLines.seasonality: Peaks at term start (Apr, Jul) when parents visit and stock up the hostel trunk
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: PediaSure 400 g ₹685, 950 g ₹1,299; Complan 500 g refill ₹294-321. With a residential school of 5-18 year-olds this is arguably the highest-volume nutraceutical line in the store. Stock the refill pouches too — cheaper per gram and parents buying for a hostel child care about that.

skuLines.examples: PediaSure 2-6 yrs BIB 400 g; AptaGrow 400 g; Nestle Lactogrow 400 g; Prohance Junior 400 g
skuLines.notes: Married staff families with small children have no substitute within 30-50 km. Verified Aug 2026: AptaGrow 400 g ₹473-491, Lactogrow 400 g ₹337, Prohance Junior 400 g ₹570. Do not confuse with infant formula (stage 1/2) which is a separate, IMS-Act-regulated line and cannot be advertised or discounted.

skuLines.line: Protein biscuits and diabetic-friendly high-protein wafers
skuLines.examples: Threptin Diskettes 275 g; Threptin Sugar-Free; Protinex Biscuits; Sugar-free protein wafers
skuLines.notes: An old-school pharmacy line that still sells to elderly and post-surgical residents. Tin format survives hill transport and monsoon humidity better than any pouch, which is a real advantage here.

skuLines.examples: MuscleBlaze Creatine Monohydrate 100 g/250 g; Nakpro Creatine 100 g; GNC Creatine; AS-IT-IS Creatine 250 g
skuLines.notes: 2026's breakout line — creatine has moved out of the gym niche into general supplement demand, including women and students buying it for energy and cognition. Unflavoured 100 g is the entry SKU. Long shelf life (24-36 months), so it is a safe line to stock on a hill route.

skuLines.examples: MuscleBlaze Pre-Workout 300; Fast&Up Pre-Workout; MB EAA; GNC BCAA
skuLines.packSizes: 250-300 g tub; 20-30 serving tubs; effervescent tubes
skuLines.notes: Two SKUs maximum. Caffeine-heavy pre-workouts are a poor fit for a residential school campus — restrict to the university-age gym cohort, and skip anything with a stimulant-blend label that reads like an energy drink.

skuLines.examples: Zincovit 15 tab; Supradyn Daily 15/60 tab; A to Z NS; Becozym C Forte 20 tab
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; strong Nov-Feb immunity lift and a post-monsoon convalescence lift
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Supradyn 15 tab ₹68, Zincovit 15 tab ₹105-110, Becozym C Forte 20 tab ₹45. The single most-asked-for nutraceutical in any Indian store. Check licence status — several of these are drug-licensed SKUs and need a retail drug licence, in which case buy the FSSAI-nutraceutical equivalent instead.

skuLines.examples: Revital H Men 30 caps; Revital H Woman 30 caps; Revital H Senior
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Revital H Woman 30 tab ₹337-375. Sells on brand recall rather than formulation — a staff member asks for 'Revital' by name. Stock the 30-count, not the 90.

skuLines.examples: Apollo Life Multivitamin for Men/Women 30 tab; HK Vitals Multivitamin; Centrum; Himalayan Organics Multivitamin
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo Life Multivitamin Men/Women 30 tab ₹200; Multivitamin 50+ ₹171-193. Better margin than the pharmacy strips and the format an educated campus staff base prefers. Must be a veg-capsule (HPMC) SKU.

skuLines.line: Senior 50+ multivitamin with joint and eye support
skuLines.examples: Apollo Life Multivitamin Men/Women 50+; Centrum Silver; HK Vitals Multivitamin for Seniors
skuLines.notes: There is a resident elderly cohort at Baru Sahib with nowhere else to buy. Pair on the shelf with calcium+D3+K2 and omega-3 — the three move together and the bundle is an easy counter recommendation.

skuLines.line: Kids multivitamin syrup and infant drops
skuLines.examples: Zincovit Syrup 200 ml; A to Z Syrup; Multivite drops; Ostocalcium B12 syrup; Zincovit drops 15 ml
skuLines.packSizes: 15 ml / 30 ml drops; 100 ml, 200 ml, 450 ml syrup
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; strong Jul-Sep monsoon lift alongside ORS and zinc
skuLines.notes: Non-negotiable for a township with married staff families and babies — a paediatric drop is what the campus doctor prescribes and there is no pharmacy within 30-50 km. Many are drug-licensed; confirm ARY's licence before listing. Once opened, syrups have a 30-day in-use life — sell the small pack.

skuLines.examples: Health Ok Mankind Gummies 30 ct; Gritzo Super Gummies 30 ct; Centrum Kids Gummies; Nutrela Kids Gummies; Little Joys Multivitamin
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; gift-driven spikes when parents visit
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Health Ok 30 ct ₹299, Gritzo 30 ct ₹489-499, Centrum Kids ₹648, Unibites ₹199. The best-margin line in the whole category. HARD CONSTRAINT: gelatin gummies will be rejected in this institution — stock pectin/plant-based only and tag the shelf. Gummies clump above ~25°C, which the hill climate helps with, but humidity is the enemy; keep the bottle sealed with its desiccant.

skuLines.line: Adult functional gummies — biotin, sleep, immunity
skuLines.examples: Dabur Siens multivitamin gummies; Wellbeing Nutrition Melts; Power Gummies Hair & Nails; Dr. Morepen Bone Support gummies
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Dr. Morepen Bone Support 60 gummies ₹539; Wellbeing Nutrition Omega Melts 30 strips ₹590. High margin, real 2026 demand, but 12-18 month shelf life and a young-adult buyer base — cap at 3-4 SKUs until it proves out.

skuLines.examples: Limcee 500 mg chewable; Celin 500; Apollo Pharmacy Vitamin C Effervescent 20 tab; HK Vitals Vitamin C
skuLines.packSizes: 15 tab strip; 20 tab effervescent tube; 60 tab bottle
skuLines.seasonality: Sharp Nov-Feb winter and Jul-Sep monsoon spikes — cough/cold season on a cold hill campus
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo Vitamin C Effervescent 20 tab ₹145. Effervescent tubes are the one format that genuinely fails in Baru Sahib humidity — the tablets swell and fizz inside the tube. Store sealed, do not break tubes open for loose sale, and keep depth low.

skuLines.examples: Calcigen D3 4 caps; Super D3 60K; Cipcal D3 60K 12 softgel; Nuvit D3 granules 10 sachets; Uprise-D3 60K
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round demand but the clinical need peaks Jun-Sep (monsoon overcast) and Dec-Feb — a cold, cloudy hill location plus modest full-cover clothing means near-universal deficiency
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Super D3 60K 4 caps ₹67, Calcigen D3 4 caps ₹112, Cipcal D3 60K 12 softgel ₹195, Nuvit D3 10 sachets ₹399. Genuinely the highest-value clinical line for THIS location and almost certainly under-stocked. Softgels are usually bovine/fish gelatin — stock the granule sachet as the vegetarian option. Long shelf life, tiny cube, so a monsoon buffer is cheap.

skuLines.line: Vitamin D3 daily low-dose, with K2
skuLines.examples: HK Vitals Vitamin D3 60 tab; Carbamide Forte D3 2000 IU; D-Rise drops (infants); TrueBasics D3+K2
skuLines.packSizes: 30-60 tab bottle; 5 ml / 15 ml infant drops
skuLines.notes: Infant vitamin D drops are the paediatric standard of care from birth and there is no alternative source on campus. Keep both the adult daily tablet and one infant drop SKU.

skuLines.examples: Becosules capsules 20 ct; Neurobion Forte 30 tab; Nurokind-LC; HK Vitals B12; Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg
skuLines.packSizes: 10-20 caps strip; 30 tab bottle; 60 tab bottle
skuLines.notes: A vegetarian institution of 5,000 people is a textbook B12-deficiency population — this line should be deep, not token. Becosules and Neurobion sell on name recall; the modern 60-tab bottle carries better margin. Watch drug-licence status on the -LC/injectable-adjacent SKUs.

skuLines.examples: HK Vitals Biotin; Power Gummies Hair & Nails; Carbamide Forte Biotin 10000 mcg; Becozym C Forte with biotin
skuLines.notes: Real demand among 18-25 women on campus, and margin is good. Two SKUs — one tablet, one gummy.

skuLines.examples: HK Vitals Calcium with Mag Zinc & D3 60/90 tab; Naturyz Calcium Plus 100 tab; GNC Calcium Plus; Vaamveda Calcium+
skuLines.marginBand: 25-40% on FSSAI nutraceutical brands; 16-20% on drug-licensed pharmacy SKUs
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: HK Vitals Calcium+MgZn+D3 60 tab ₹319 / 90 tab ₹449; Naturyz 100 tab ₹249; Shelcal-HD 15 tab ₹170; Cipcal-500 15 tab ₹86. LICENCE SPLIT MATTERS: Shelcal / Cipcal / Gemcal / Calcimax are drug-licensed and need a retail drug licence; the HK Vitals / Naturyz style products are FSSAI nutraceuticals and do not. If ARY has no drug licence, stock the nutraceutical side — it also carries double the margin.

skuLines.line: Calcium + D3 + K2/MK7 premium bone formula
skuLines.examples: TrueBasics Advance Calcium D3 & K2MK7 90 tab; Himalayan Organics Calcium Citrate Malate; Bon K2
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: TrueBasics Calcium D3+K2MK7 90 tab ₹929; Himalayan Organics 120 tab ₹729. Post-menopausal staff and elderly residents are the buyers. One or two SKUs; sell it as the counter upgrade from the plain calcium tablet.

skuLines.line: Calcium syrup and chewable for children
skuLines.examples: Ostocalcium B12 syrup 200 ml; Calcimax-P suspension 200 ml; Macalvit chewable; kids calcium gummies
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Calcimax-P suspension 200 ml ₹192; Dr. Morepen Bone Support gummies 60 ct ₹539. Growing children 5-18 in a residential school with limited sun exposure in monsoon — this and vitamin D are the paired paediatric lines. Syrups are glass or heavy PET: pack carefully for hill transport, breakage is a real cost.

skuLines.examples: Tata 1mg Iron & Folic Acid 10 tab; Carbamide Forte Chelated Iron 60/100 tab; Autrin; Ferheam-XT; INLIFE Iron Folic
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Tata 1mg Iron+Folic 10 tab ₹106; Carbamide Forte 60 tab ₹375, 100 tab ₹499-569; Ferheam-XT 10 tab ₹130. Anaemia prevalence among Indian adolescent girls and women makes this a must-have in a population with a large teenage-girl and married-women cohort. Chelated (bisglycinate) versions are gentler on the stomach and worth the shelf tag.

skuLines.examples: Dexorange syrup; Haemocal tonic 300 ml; Ferrosym 300/450 ml; Igobin syrup; Ferrochelate XT syrup 150 ml
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Haemocal 300 ml ₹181; Ferrosym 300 ml ₹216 / 450 ml ₹290; Ferrochelate XT 150 ml ₹181. What the campus doctor writes for an anaemic teenager who cannot swallow tablets. Iron syrups stain teeth and clothes — tell the buyer, it prevents returns.

skuLines.examples: Zincovit tablets; Zinconia; Zinc gluconate 50 mg; zinc dispersible 20 mg for paediatric diarrhoea
skuLines.packSizes: 10-15 tab strip; 60 tab bottle; 30-60 ml syrup
skuLines.seasonality: Sharp Jul-Sep monsoon spike — the WHO diarrhoea protocol is ORS + 14 days of zinc, and this is a heavy-monsoon location
skuLines.notes: Must be shelved physically NEXT TO the ORS. Selling ORS without zinc is the single most common gap in Indian retail paediatric care, and in a township where the nearest chemist is 30-50 km away it is the gap that matters most.

skuLines.examples: HK Vitals Magnesium; Carbamide Forte Magnesium Glycinate; HealthAid Magnesium Orotate; Miduty Magnesium
skuLines.notes: A 2025-26 riser bought for sleep, cramps and stress rather than for a deficiency. One glycinate SKU is enough for now; it is the fastest-growing single mineral in Indian D2C.

skuLines.examples: Apollo Life Omega-3 1000 mg 30 caps; HK Vitals Fish Oil 60 caps; WOW Omega-3 Triple Strength; Neuherbs Deep Sea Fish Oil
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo Life Omega-3 1000 mg 30 caps ₹176; triple-strength SKUs ₹880-2,075. IMPORTANT for this institution: fish oil is non-vegetarian and a bovine/fish gelatin shell — it will be refused by many residents. Stock it for those who want it, but never as the ONLY omega line.

skuLines.line: Cod liver oil capsules and liquid
skuLines.examples: Seacod Cod Liver Oil 100 caps / 60 ml; Apollo Life Cod Liver Oil 300 mg 100 caps; Seven Seas
skuLines.seasonality: Winter lift Nov-Feb — traditional cold-weather tonic
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo Life Cod Liver Oil 300 mg 100 caps ₹199; Seacod 60 ml ₹293. Sells on tradition in hill and North Indian households. Same non-vegetarian caveat as fish oil.

skuLines.line: Vegetarian omega-3 — algal DHA and flaxseed oil
skuLines.examples: Apollo Life Flaxseed Oil Omega 3-6-9 30 caps; Himalayan Organics Vegan Omega 3 90 caps; Unived Vegan Omega-3 (algal)
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo Life Flaxseed Omega 3-6-9 30 caps ₹280; Himalayan Organics Vegan Omega 3 90 caps ₹1,170. This is the omega SKU that actually fits a Sikh vegetarian institution, and it is the one most likely missing. Algal DHA is the only vegetarian source of true EPA/DHA — flaxseed (ALA) is not equivalent, so stock at least one algal SKU and say so on the tag.

skuLines.line: Kids DHA / omega drops and gummies
skuLines.examples: Little Joys DHA Omega 3 Brain Gummies; Wellbeing Nutrition Kids Omega Melts; algal DHA drops for infants
skuLines.seasonality: Exam-season lift (Nov, Feb-Mar) on the brain/concentration claim
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Little Joys DHA Brain Gummies ₹549; Wellbeing Nutrition Omega Marvel 30 strips ₹590. Parents of school children buy on the concentration claim. Must be plant/algal and gelatin-free for this campus.

skuLines.examples: Dabur Chyawanprash 500 g / 1 kg; Baidyanath Chyawanprash Special; Patanjali Chyawanprash; Apollo Life Chyawan Health Gold 1 kg
skuLines.packSizes: 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg jar (also 2 kg family pack)
skuLines.seasonality: Heavily seasonal — Oct to Feb is the bulk of annual volume. A cold hill winter makes this the flagship immunity SKU of the store from Diwali onward
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo Life Chyawan Health Gold 1 kg ₹337; Amazon mainstream 1 kg ₹330-545, 500 g ₹250-440. Buy the winter stock in Sep-Oct BEFORE monsoon road risk clears and before the seasonal price rise. 24-36 month shelf life so over-buying is survivable, which is rare in this category. The 1 kg jar is the institutional/hostel SKU — pre-book with messes.

skuLines.examples: Dabur Chyawanprakash Sugar Free; Apollo Life Sugar Free Chyawanprash 900 g; Baidyanath Kesar Chyawanprash; Zandu Kesari Jivan
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo Life Sugar Free Chyawanprash 900 g ₹337; Amazon premium/kesar 500 g ₹335-645. Sugar-free is not a niche any more — diabetic staff and elderly residents are a large slice of the winter buyer base, and the standard chyawanprash is roughly half sugar. Stock the sugar-free variant alongside, not instead.

skuLines.examples: Dabur Giloy Juice 1 L; Dabur Giloy Neem Tulsi Juice 1 L; Baidyanath Giloy Juice 1 L; Patanjali Giloy Juice 500 ml
skuLines.seasonality: Peaks Jul-Sep (monsoon fever season) and Nov-Feb
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Dabur Giloy Juice 1 L ₹203, Giloy Neem Tulsi 1 L ₹234; Baidyanath 1 L ₹180-246; Patanjali 500 ml ₹90. TELL THE BUYER: once opened, a 1 L juice bottle needs refrigeration and finishing in ~30 days — in a hill household without a fridge the 500 ml is the honest recommendation. Heavy and glass-or-PET, so freight per rupee of sale is poor; order full cases with the regular truck.

skuLines.examples: Patanjali Giloy Ghan Vati 40 g; Baidyanath Giloy Ghan Bati 60 tab; Himalaya Guduchi 60 ct; Siddhayu Giloy Tablets
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Patanjali Giloy Ghan Vati 40 g ₹56; Baidyanath Ghan Bati 60 tab ₹109; Himalaya Guduchi 60 ct ₹234; Siddhayu 60+20 tab ₹125. Far better than juice on a hill route — light, no refrigeration, 24-36 month shelf life, no spoilage after opening. This should be the primary giloy format for Baru Sahib and the juice the secondary.

skuLines.examples: Patanjali Ashwagandha Churna/Tablets; Himalaya Ashvagandha 60 ct; Apollo Life Ashwagandha Extract 30 caps; KSM-66 standardised (Himalayan Organics, TrueBasics)
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo Life Ashwagandha Extract 30 caps ₹422; Patanjali 40 g ₹56. Stock both ends — the ₹56 churna for traditional buyers and one standardised KSM-66 SKU for the 18-25 cohort who read labels. Veg capsule shell required.

skuLines.line: Tulsi drops, kadha and Ayush Kwath
skuLines.examples: Dabur Tulsi Drops 30 ml; Patanjali Tulsi Panchang Drops; Kapiva/Baidyanath Ayush Kwath; Dabur Honitus Hot Sip
skuLines.packSizes: 15-30 ml drops; 60-100 g kwath powder; 4-10 g sachets
skuLines.seasonality: Strong Nov-Feb and Jul-Sep — cough, cold and fever season on a cold, wet hill campus
skuLines.notes: Cheap, light, long shelf life, and exactly what a cold-climate Indian household reaches for first. Sachet format is the winner — a hostel warden can hand out single sachets. Pair on the shelf with honey, ginger and the vitamin C strip.

skuLines.examples: Dabur Amla Juice 1 L; Patanjali Amla Juice; Apollo Pharmacy Amla Candy 250 g; Baidyanath Amla Murabba
skuLines.packSizes: 250 g candy; 500 ml, 1 L juice; 500 g-1 kg murabba
skuLines.seasonality: Winter (amla is a winter crop; murabba and candy peak Nov-Feb)
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo Pharmacy Amla Candy 250 g ₹84. Candy is the sleeper SKU — children buy it themselves, it needs no dosing, and it sits happily at the POS counter. Vitamin C plus tradition in one line.

skuLines.examples: Dabur Shilajit Gold caps; Patanjali Shilajit Sat; Kapiva Himalayan Shilajit resin 20 g; Upakarma Shilajit
skuLines.notes: Strong margin and a genuine Himalayan-provenance story that sells well in a Himachal location. Keep it to 2 SKUs and be careful with claims — this is the category with the most aggressive and least substantiated marketing in Indian ayurveda.

skuLines.examples: Patanjali Triphala Churna 100 g; Baidyanath Triphala tablets; Dabur Triphala Churna; Hingwastak churna
skuLines.notes: Constipation is a genuine, high-frequency complaint in an elderly and sedentary-staff population on a low-fibre institutional mess diet. Cheap, light, long-lived — an easy line to carry deep.

skuLines.examples: Dabur Honitus; Dabur Chyawanprash for Kids; Zandu Kesari Jivan; Baidyanath Balamrit; Himalaya Septilin syrup
skuLines.notes: A residential school of 5-18 year-olds in a cold, wet climate runs a near-continuous cough-and-cold season. This is what a hostel matron and a mother both buy. Keep the small pack — in-use life after opening is short.

skuLines.examples: Electral 21.8 g sachet; Apollo Life ORS Lemon/Orange 21.8 g; Prolyte; ORS-L powder
skuLines.priceBand: ₹21-25 per 21.8 g sachet; ₹105-210 per 5-10 pack; ₹600 per 30-pack
skuLines.seasonality: Sharp Apr-Jul (heat) and Jul-Sep (monsoon gastroenteritis) peaks; needed year-round
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo ORS 21.8 g ₹21; Electral 10x21.8 g ₹209, 30x21.8 g ₹599, 30x4.4 g ₹121. THE most important single line in this category for Baru Sahib — a dehydrated child 30-50 km from a hospital on a monsoon-damaged hill road is the scenario that kills, and a ₹21 sachet is the answer. Carry a deliberate 8-week monsoon buffer, never stock out, and shelve zinc beside it. 24-36 month shelf life makes the buffer nearly free.

skuLines.examples: Apollo Pharmacy ORS Orange 200 ml; Apollo Life ORS Lemon liquid; Apollo Life Electro Choice Apple/Orange/Pomegranate 200 ml; Electral RTD
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo ORS 200 ml ₹31; Electro Choice 200 ml ₹33. No mixing, no measuring, no clean-water question — which is exactly why it wins with a panicked parent at 11 pm. Heavier freight than sachets, so keep sachets as the volume line and RTD as the convenience line. Note: FSSAI has been pushing back on non-ORS-formula drinks using the 'ORS' name; check the label carries the WHO formula, not just the word.

skuLines.examples: Glucon-D Regular / Nimbu Pani / Tangy Orange; Apollo Pharmacy Glucose-D 82.5 g; Dabur Glucose-D; Glucovita
skuLines.packSizes: 75-100 g sachet/pouch; 200 g, 400 g, 1 kg jar/pouch
skuLines.seasonality: Heavy Apr-Jul summer peak; also every sports day, trek and langar-duty shift
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Apollo Glucose-D 82.5 g ₹24. Thin margin, high rotation, universal recognition — a footfall line, not a profit line. The 1 kg pouch is the canteen and sports-event SKU. Cakes solid in monsoon humidity if the pouch is opened; sell small packs and keep stock sealed.

skuLines.examples: Enerzal Orange/Apple 500 g & 50 g sachet; Rebalanz; Fast&Up Reload; Glucon-D Electro-C
skuLines.packSizes: 50 g sachet; 200 g, 500 g jar; RTD 200-500 ml
skuLines.notes: Sits between medical ORS and sports hydration, and is what a school sports meet or a university trek actually consumes in volume. Sachets for individuals, 500 g jars for the sports department — an easy institutional sale.

skuLines.examples: MB Fuel One Hydr8 20 tab; Fast&Up Hydration Reload 20/40/60 tab; GNC Hydra Rush 15 sachets; Dr. Morepen Hydrolyte 10 sachets
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: MB Fuel One Hydr8 20 tab ₹199; Fast&Up Reload 40 tab ₹418; GNC Hydra Rush 15 sachets ₹549; Dr. Morepen Hydrolyte 10 sachets ₹324. Two SKUs at most. Effervescent tubes are the format most likely to be ruined by Baru Sahib humidity — keep them sealed, low depth, and off any damp wall.

skuLines.examples: Darolac sachets; Vibact DS; Enterogermina 5 ml vials; HK Vitals Probiotic; Sporlac
skuLines.packSizes: 1 g sachet (strip of 10); 10-30 capsules; 5 ml vials
skuLines.seasonality: Strong Jul-Sep monsoon peak alongside ORS and zinc
skuLines.notes: The third leg of the monsoon diarrhoea trio (ORS + zinc + probiotic) and the one Indian stores most often skip. Some SKUs need cool storage and all lose potency in heat — the hill climate is an advantage, but check whether the brand demands 2-8°C, because ARY's warehouse cold-chain, if any, is the limiting factor.

skuLines.examples: Folic acid 5 mg tablets; Carbamide Forte Iron for Pregnancy; Prohance Mom 400 g; Protinex Mother's 400 g; prenatal DHA
skuLines.packSizes: 10-30 tab strips; 60-100 tab bottles; 400 g powder
skuLines.notes: Verified Aug 2026: Prohance Mom 400 g ₹567; Protinex Mother's 400 g ₹537. Married staff families with small children implies an ongoing pregnancy cohort, and folic acid in the first trimester is not a thing to be 30-50 km away from. Keep folic acid, calcium, iron and one maternal powder together as a visible corner.

VEG CONSTRAINT: most collagen is bovine or marine and glucosamine is often shellfish-derived — both are unacceptable to a large share of this population. Stock a vegetarian 'collagen builder' (vitamin C + amino acids) and a non-shellfish glucosamine, and label them clearly, or this line will sit.

skuLines.line: Sleep and stress support (melatonin, magnesium, ashwagandha blends)

Melatonin's regulatory position in India is unsettled between food supplement and drug — check the licence category of the specific SKU before listing, and prefer the ashwagandha/magnesium framing which is unambiguously a nutraceutical.

skuLines.examples: Green tea extract capsules; Apple cider vinegar tablets/gummies; Garcinia cambogia; Patanjali Divya Medohar Vati
skuLines.notes: Two SKUs, front-of-shelf, no claims. Sedentary staff on a carbohydrate-heavy mess diet is a real demand pool, but this is the category where over-promising damages a single-store monopoly's credibility fastest — and in a closed township, word travels in a day.

trends2026: Gummies and effervescents are the fastest-growing delivery formats in Indian supplements — pectin (vegetarian) gummies for kids and adults, single-serve sachets, effervescent tubes. Dabur launched Siens (Jun 2025) as a digital-first premium brand with multivitamin gummies, marine collagen and probiotics; 'India's first doctor-formulated gummy vitamin brand' launched 2024. Format is now expected on shelf, not novel.

Creatine monohydrate has broken out of the gym niche into general supplement demand — women, students and older buyers purchasing it for energy and cognition, not just muscle. 100 g and 250 g tubs are now a mainstream retail line, and it is one of the few supplements with a 24-36 month shelf life that suits a remote hill store.

Protein-ification of the mass market: high-protein claims have migrated from sports nutrition into everyday nutrition powders, biscuits, bars and RTDs. India's protein supplements market was ~USD 913 mn in 2025 growing ~6.3% CAGR to 2034, but the mass 'nutrition powder' end (Protinex, Complan, PediaSure, Ensure) is growing faster than the whey end and is where a township store makes its volume.

Electrolyte hydration has split away from medical ORS into a lifestyle category — tablets, sachets and zero-sugar mixes (MB Fuel One Hydr8 ₹199/20 tab, Fast&Up Reload, GNC Hydra Rush, Dr. Morepen Hydrolyte). Alongside this, FSSAI pressure on non-WHO-formula drinks using the 'ORS' name is forcing relabelling, so the word on the pack no longer guarantees the formula.

Vegetarian, vegan and gelatin-free has become a hard purchase filter rather than a preference — algal DHA replacing fish oil, HPMC/pullulan capsules replacing gelatin softgels, pectin gummies replacing gelatin. For a Sikh institution this outranks price: a gelatin gummy or a fish-oil-only omega shelf simply will not sell.

Ayurveda modernised into standardised extracts and daily-dose formats — KSM-66 ashwagandha, giloy ghan vati tablets displacing 1 L juice bottles, sugar-free and jaggery-sweetened chyawanprash. Amway India is exploring an Ayurvedic entry within 2-3 years and Herbalife partnered with IIT Madras on plant-fermentation of herbal ingredients, so the mainstream is moving in.

Sugar-free and no-added-sugar reformulation is sweeping the traditional lines: sugar-free chyawanprash (Apollo Life 900 g ₹337), no-added-sugar kids gummies, diabetic nutrition powders (Ensure Diabetes Care 950 g ₹1,810 is now a top seller). Driven by diabetes prevalence and front-of-pack labelling pressure.

Q-commerce and D2C have reset price transparency and pack architecture — single-serve sachets, 30-day pouches, 90-day subscription packs. India's dietary supplements market runs ₹201 bn (2025) to ₹573 bn by 2034 at ~12.3% CAGR, with pharmacies still the largest single channel at ~36%, and North India the largest region at ~35% of nutraceutical demand.
adjacentServices: Monthly standing-order refill billed to the staff or family campus account — calcium+D3, vitamin D3 60K, B12, iron, Ensure Diabetes, Protinex. These are chronic-use products bought by the same 100-200 households every single month; a standing order converts the highest-margin recurring demand in the store into guaranteed volume and kills the stock-out that sends a wallet to town.

A weighing scale, BP monitor and BMI chart at the counter, plus a monthly Hb and blood-sugar screening morning run jointly with the Eternal University health centre. Screening creates the diagnosis that creates the sale, and it is the cheapest credibility a single-store monopoly can buy.

A campus-doctor slip counter: the physician writes a supplement, ARY commits to stocking that exact brand within one indent cycle instead of the family riding 30-50 km of hill road for a ₹200 bottle. Keep a written indent book at the counter for anything not on shelf.

Gym and sports-department tie-up: whey and creatine sold by the single serve with a shaker programme, plus a pre-event ORS/electrolyte/glucose kit for treks, sports meets and langar duty shifts. Institutional sale to the sports department, individual sale to the student.

Institutional winter pre-book with the hostels and messes — 1 kg chyawanprash jars, vitamin D3 sachets, Glucon-D 1 kg pouches, tulsi/kadha sachets — indented in September before monsoon road risk and the seasonal price rise.

A maternal-and-infant nutrition corner run with the campus nurse: prenatal folic acid, iron, calcium, maternal powders, lactation granules, infant vitamin D drops, ORS and zinc in one visible place. The buyer here is the least mobile person in the township.

A permanent vegetarian / gelatin-free shelf tag system, so residents stop reading ingredient panels and start trusting the shelf. In this institution that tag does more for conversion than any discount.

Expiry discipline as a service: a near-expiry clearance shelf, a return-to-vendor routine, and a 6-8 week monsoon buffer on the never-stock-out lines (ORS, zinc, vitamin D3, paediatric drops). Supplements die of expiry more than of theft, and a landslide-closed road is the one risk a hill store must pre-fund.
